KISWAHILI — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #14
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: KISWAHILI
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Ni sentensi ipi iliyo sahihi kisarufi? (1 mark)
   A. Kitabu anasoma mwanafunzi kwa.
   B. Mwanafunzi anasoma vitabu mzuri.
   C. Anasoma mwanafunzi kitabu ya.
   D. Mwanafunzi anasoma kitabu.

2. When practising Kusikiliza na Kujibu Mjadala, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Kusikiliza na Kujibu Mjadala.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Kusikiliza na Kujibu Mjadala.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Kusikiliza na Kujibu Mjadala.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Kusikiliza na Kujibu Mjadala.

3. When practising Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza 1.1.1 Kusikiliza na Kujibu Mjadala, which approach is best? (1 mark)

   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza 1.1.1 Kusikiliza na Kujibu Mjadala.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza 1.1.1 Kusikiliza na Kujibu Mjadala.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza 1.1.1 Kusikiliza na Kujibu Mjadala.

4. Kinyume cha “refu” ni: (1 mark)
   A. zito
   B. fupi
   C. nene
   D. pana

5. When practising Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza 2.1.1 Kusikiliza kwa Kina Sauti /b/ na /mb/, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza 2.1.1 Kusikiliza kwa Kina Sauti /b/ na /mb/.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza 2.1.1 Kusikiliza kwa Kina Sauti /b/ na /mb/.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza 2.1.1 Kusikiliza kwa Kina Sauti /b/ na /mb/.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza 2.1.1 Kusikiliza kwa Kina Sauti /b/ na /mb/.

6. When practising Sarufi 1.4.1 Vihusishi vya mahali wakati, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Sarufi 1.4.1 Vihusishi vya mahali wakati.

   C. Use insults to “practise” Sarufi 1.4.1 Vihusishi vya mahali wakati.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Sarufi 1.4.1 Vihusishi vya mahali wakati.

7. When practising Kusikiliza kwa Kina Sauti /b/ na /mb/, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Kusikiliza kwa Kina Sauti /b/ na /mb/.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Kusikiliza kwa Kina Sauti /b/ na /mb/.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Kusikiliza kwa Kina Sauti /b/ na /mb/.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Kusikiliza kwa Kina Sauti /b/ na /mb/.

8. When practising Kusoma 2.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana Matini ya kujichagulia, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Kusoma 2.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana Matini ya kujichagulia.

   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Kusoma 2.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana Matini ya kujichagulia.

9. When practising Sarufi 2.4.1 Vihusishi -a unganifu sababu, which approach is best? (1 mark)

10. When practising Kuandika 1.3.1 Viakifishi, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Kuandika 1.3.1 Viakifishi.

   B. mato

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Sarufi 6.4.1 Vielezi namna wakati and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza 7.1.1 Kusikiliza kwa Kutathmini and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Kusikiliza kwa Kutathmini and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Kusoma 7 .2.1 Ufupisho and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

2. C — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Kusikiliza na Kujibu Mjadala.

3. B — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza 1.1.1 Kusikiliza na Kujibu Mjadala.
